title: Add power/session controls (Lock Screen, Leave) to the off-by-default desktop Application Menu launcher thingy
line: The desktop's right-click Application Menu now ends with Lock Screen and Show Logout Screen.
explanation: When the desktop's right-click action is set to Application Menu, the menu only listed application categories, so with no panels there was no graphical way to lock or leave the session. The standard desktop menu has Lock Screen and Show Logout Screen, but the applauncher containment action never had them. The applauncher now appends a separator and the same two actions (same names, icons and KAuthorized checks as the standard menu), driven by SessionManagement.

commits.message:
containmentactions/applauncher: add Lock Screen and Show Logout Screen

With the desktop's right-click set to the Application Menu there was no
way to lock or leave the session from it, unlike the standard menu. The
menu now ends with the same Lock Screen and Show Logout Screen actions.

BUG: 479281

media.caption: Desktop right-click set to Application Menu: only app categories, no way to lock or log out
Same menu with the fix: Lock Screen and Show Logout Screen at the bottom
Clicking Show Logout Screen opens the logout screen
Clicking Lock Screen locks the session
